overview_description.description: Season is a platform that offers personalized nutrition planning for consumers. It integrates technology with advice from users' registered dietitians to help them get more out of their nutrition and make the most out of mealtime every day. The platform recommends what to eat for breakfast, lunch, and dinner based on nutritional needs, food preferences, and budget.

about_short_description.short_description: Season is a food recommendation platform that offers personalized nutrition planning for consumers.

product.name: Virtual Dietitian Visits
product.description: Online consultations with board-certified dietitians covered by insurance to provide personalized nutrition care for various health conditions.

product.name: Personalized Nutrition Consultation
product.description: Initial and follow-up sessions with dietitians to create and adjust individualized nutrition plans based on patient health goals and conditions.

product.name: Online Food Marketplace
product.description: A platform offering recipes and prepared meals tailored to patients' personalized nutrition plans, with options for delivery and pick-up.

product.name: Condition-Specific Nutrition Programs
product.description: Specialized nutrition care programs focusing on managing specific health conditions through tailored diet plans and expert dietitian support.

product.name: Insurance-Covered Nutrition Care
product.description: Nutrition services including dietitian visits and consultations that are covered by most insurance plans, reducing patient out-of-pocket costs.
